subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw commit a root Microsoft tracker file and GitHub-mutating generator script, or keep this tracker as a PR-body/admin workflow outside the source tree?
rationale: The code blockers are repairable, but committing a living tracker and PR-body updater is a maintainer workflow/product choice, and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Keep And Harden
options.body: Accept the tracker direction, but require the generator safety fixes, check mode, valid Markdown, no changelog edit, and real-run proof before merge.

options.title: Keep As PR Workflow
options.body: Do not commit the tracker or generator; continue using the PR body/comments as the live Microsoft work queue.

options.title: Close As Admin Churn
options.body: Close this branch if a committed tracker is not worth the maintenance and automation risk.

recommendation.title: Keep And Harden
recommendation.body: Accept the tracker direction, but require the generator safety fixes, check mode, valid Markdown, no changelog edit, and real-run proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is release/admin-policy shaped, and current-main policy/history points to @steipete as the strongest routing candidate.
